projects.title: Parkinson's Disease Treatment Research
projects.description: Conducted statistical analysis and built predictive ML models (Random Forests, Logistic Regression) using Python and scikit-learn to evaluate wearable/smartphone cue effectiveness for Parkinson's disease drooling treatment. Developed personalized treatment schedule prediction system achieving 65% F1-score accuracy. Received MSc Distinction for dissertation demonstrating rigorous research methodology.
